title: 💰 Master Fines & Penalty Matrix (All Tiers & Rationales)
summary:
• Minor Administrative Tier (NT$300–$1,200): Minor documentation defects (NT$300–600), unfastened seatbelt on urban roads (NT$1,500), motorcycle helmet violation (NT$500).
• Medium Tier (NT$1,000–$3,000): Handheld phone while driving car (NT$3,000 flat vs NT$1,000 moto); Leaving/fleeing scene of property-only accident without injuries (NT$1,000–$3,000 + 1 to 3 months driver license suspension).
• Intersection & Signal Tier (NT$1,800–$5,400): Running red light at standard intersection (NT$1,800–$5,400 + 3 demerit points); Right turn on red (NT$600–$1,800 + 1 point); Running red light at LRT/tram intersection (NT$3,600–$10,800).
• Severe & Unlicensed Tier (NT$6,000–$24,000): Driving without valid license or while suspended (NT$6,000–$24,000 + vehicle impounded on the spot); Lending vehicle to unlicensed driver (3-month vehicle license plate suspension).
• Emergency & Dangerous Driving Tier (NT$6,000–$36,000): Failure to yield to ambulance/fire engine with sirens active (NT$6,000–$30,000 + MANDATORY LICENSE REVOCATION + 6 months plate suspension); Dangerous driving / Severe speeding ≥40 km/h over limit (NT$6,000–$36,000 + 6 months plate suspension + 6 months license suspension + safety training).
• Extreme Public Hazard Tier (NT$30,000–$90,000): Street racing / Speed contests in groups (NT$30,000–$90,000 + License Revocation + 3-year retest ban + Vehicle confiscation).
• Violation Accumulation: 3 vehicle moving violations within 3 months = 1-month vehicle plate suspension.
key_numbers: NT$1,500: Seatbelt unfastened on urban roads (NT$3,000–6,000 on freeways/expressways)
NT$3,000: Handheld mobile phone while driving car (NT$1,000 for motorcycles)
NT$1,800 – 5,400: Running red light (+ 3 demerit points)
NT$6,000 – 30,000: Blocking emergency ambulance with siren (+ License Revocation)
NT$6,000 – 36,000: Speeding ≥40 km/h over limit (+ 6 months license plate suspension)
12 demerit points in 1 year = 2 months driver license suspension
3 violations in 3 months = 1 month vehicle plate suspension

title: 🔊 Noise, Mufflers, Equipment Modifications & Confiscations
summary:
• Progressive Escalation for Noise & Removed Mufflers (Article 43):
  - 1st Offense: Fine of NT$6,000 to NT$24,000, on-the-spot driving ban, and 6-MONTH VEHICLE LICENSE PLATE SUSPENSION + Confiscation of illegal noise device.
  - 2nd Offense within 1 Year (Repeat): 6-MONTH DRIVER'S LICENSE SUSPENSION.
• Window Tinting Standards (Visible Light Transmittance - VLT):
  - Mandatory for newly registered private passenger cars starting February 28, 2026 (ROC Year 115).
  - Front windshield and front side windows must have a Visible Light Transmittance (VLT) ≥ 70%.
• Equipment & Vehicle Confiscations:
  - Unlawfully loud horns and noise devices are CONFISCATED on the spot.
  - Illegally assembled cars or scrapped vehicles driven on public roads are CONFISCATED and scrapped.
  - Forged, altered, or fraudulent license plates are CONFISCATED immediately.

6-month LICENSE suspension: 2nd repeat offense within 1 year for noise / muffler
VLT ≥ 70%: Minimum visible light transmittance for front windshield from 2026
Horn duration: Maximum 0.5 seconds (half a second) per press; max 2 consecutive honks
Private car periodic inspections: <5 yrs exempt; 5–10 yrs 1x/year; ≥10 yrs 2x/year

title: 🚇 Long Tunnels, Freeways, Speeds & Adverse Weather
summary:
• Long Tunnels (≥ 4 km, e.g., Hsuehshan Tunnel):
  - Normal cruising distance: Minimum 50 meters for small cars (100 meters for heavy vehicles).
  - Traffic Jam / Standstill Distance (<20 km/h or stopped): MAINTAIN AT LEAST 20 METERS behind preceding vehicle (prevents chain-reaction fire spread and allows emergency vehicle access).
  - Hsuehshan Tunnel Speed Limits: Minimum 70 km/h, Maximum 90 km/h.
  - Low-beam headlights mandatory 24/7. No lane changing (solid white line).
  - Tunnel Fire Protocol: Pull to right, turn off engine, LEAVE KEYS IN IGNITION/CAR, LEAVE DOORS UNLOCKED, crawl low and evacuate ON FOOT IN OPPOSITE DIRECTION OF TRAFFIC FLOW towards cross-tunnel pedestrian evacuation doors.
• National Freeways:
  - Small Car Following Distance Formula: Speed (km/h) ÷ 2 in meters (e.g. 100 km/h = 50m; 90 km/h = 45m; 70 km/h = 35m).
  - Heavy Truck Following Distance Formula: Speed (km/h) - 20 in meters (e.g. 100 km/h = 80m; 90 km/h = 70m).
  - Innermost (Left) Lane: Strictly for overtaking or cruising at maximum legal speed limit of the segment.
  - Slow vehicles (<80 km/h in ≥90 km/h zones): Must drive in outer lane.
  - Heavy Fog / Torrential Rain (Visibility <100m): Reduce speed to below 40 km/h.
  - Warning Triangle Breakdown Distance: 100 meters behind on freeways (100–200m in dense fog/curves).

100 meters: Safe following distance for heavy trucks in long tunnels
20 meters: Mandatory distance in long tunnels during standstill / speeds <20 km/h
70 – 90 km/h: Official speed range in Hsuehshan Tunnel
Speed ÷ 2 (m): Small car freeway following distance formula (e.g. 70 km/h = 35m)
Speed - 20 (m): Heavy vehicle freeway distance formula (e.g. 90 km/h = 70m)
<40 km/h: Maximum speed on freeways during dense fog or torrential rain
100 meters: Triangle breakdown warning distance on freeways and expressways
50 meters: Triangle distance on 50–60 km/h roads (5–30m on roads ≤40 km/h)

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When a fire occurs inside a long tunnel, you should stop the engine and:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (3) All persons evacuate, leave windows half open, leave the keys in the vehicle, and do not lock the doors.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: In tunnel fire: turn off engine, LEAVE KEYS IN CAR, LEAVE DOORS UNLOCKED, and evacuate towards pedestrian exits.

title: 🚆 Railway Level Crossings: Stop Distances, Fines & SOS Protocol
summary:
• Unattended Railway Crossing (No gates or warning bells):
  - Driver must come to a COMPLETE STOP between 3 and 6 METERS before the nearest rail, look both ways, and listen before crossing.
• Approach Speed Limit: Maximum 15 km/h upon seeing railway crossing advance warning.
• Severe Sanctions under Article 54:
  - Overtaking, U-turns, reversing, stopping, or forcing passage when gates are lowering or bells ringing carries FINE OF NT$15,000 TO NT$90,000 + 1-YEAR DRIVER LICENSE SUSPENSION + Mandatory safety course.
  - Causing accident on railway tracks: PERMANENT LICENSE REVOCATION (Lifetime retest ban).
• 3-Step SOS Emergency Protocol (Car stalled on tracks):
  1. Press (按): The red emergency SOS button on the railway crossing post.
  2. Push (推): Attempt to push the vehicle clear of the tracks.
  3. Evacuate (跑): If train approaches or car cannot move, immediately run sideways away from tracks.
  - Taiwan Railways 24/7 Toll-Free Emergency Hotline: 1933.

15 km/h or below: Maximum approach speed near railway crossings
NT$15,000 – NT$90,000: Fine for illegal maneuvers or forcing through crossings
1-year license suspension: Mandatory penalty for railway crossing violations

title: 🍷 Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Escalations, Passenger Liability & Door Safety
category: Alcohol Laws, Passenger Safety & Door Protocols
summary:
• Legal Alcohol Limits & Progressive Sanctions:
  - Administrative Limit (≥0.15 mg/L breath / 0.03% blood): Car fine NT$30,000–$120,000 (Moto NT$15k–$90k) + 1 to 2-year license suspension + On-the-spot vehicle impoundment + 2-year plate suspension.
  - Criminal Threshold (≥0.25 mg/L breath / 0.05% blood): Public Endangerment crime subject to criminal trial and up to 3 years imprisonment.
  - 10-Year Repeat DUI Offense (2nd time): Maximum fine (NT$120,000 car / NT$90,000 moto) + 3-year License Revocation + Public disclosure of name and photo on government portal. (3rd offense adds NT$90,000 increment).
  - Sobriety Breathalyzer Refusal (1st refusal): NT$180,000 flat fine + MANDATORY IMMEDIATE LICENSE REVOCATION (3-year retest ban) + Vehicle impoundment. (2nd refusal in 10 years = NT$360,000).
  - Adult Passenger Co-Liability: Passengers aged 18 to 70 riding with drunk driver (BAC ≥0.25) are fined NT$6,000 to NT$15,000.
  - Commercial Bus Driver DUI: License revoked and BANNED FROM RETESTING FOR 4 YEARS.
  - Alcohol Ignition Interlock: Mandatory 1-year installation upon license restoration (car will not start unless breath tests 0.00).
• Two-Stage Door Opening Protocol:
  - 1. Check rearview mirror and shoulder check -> 2. Crack door open ~15 cm to confirm clearance -> 3. Open fully and exit.

0.25 mg/L (0.05% blood): Criminal threshold (criminal trial + prison sentence)
NT$180,000: Flat fine for refusing breathalyzer test (1st refusal; 2nd = NT$360,000)
NT$6,000 – NT$15,000: Fine on adult passengers (18+) riding with drunk driver
4 years: Retest ban duration for commercial bus drivers convicted of DUI
10 years: Lookback window for counting repeat DUI violations
1 year: Mandatory installation period for Alcohol Ignition Interlock

tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: DUI fine CANNOT be replaced with license suspension (both fine and suspension are strictly mandatory).

tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Passengers aged under 18 or over 70 are EXEMPT from the passenger DUI fine.

tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Alcohol causes 'tunnel vision', resulting in a NARROWER visual field.

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (2) The insurance company may exercise its right of subrogation to recover the paid compensation from the drunk driver.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Compulsory insurance pays the innocent victim and then exercises SUBROGATION to recover 100% from drunk driver.

title: 🛑 Right-of-Way, Intersections, Roundabouts & Mountain Roads
summary:
• Traffic Control Hierarchy: 1. Traffic Police Hand Gestures > 2. Traffic Lights > 3. Static Signs > 4. Road Markings.
• Intersection Priority Rules:
  - Straight > Turning: Straight-moving vehicle has absolute priority over turning vehicle.
  - Opposite Turning into Same Single Lane: Left-turning vehicle has priority over right-turning vehicle (right-turning yields to left-turning).
  - Opposite Turning into Multi-lane Road: Left-turn enters inner lane; Right-turn enters outer lane.
  - Equal Uncontrolled Intersection: Left-side vehicle yields to vehicle coming from the RIGHT.
  - Roundabouts: Vehicles entering roundabout must yield to vehicles already CIRCULATING INSIDE. On multi-lane roundabouts, outer lane yields to inner lane.
• Mountain Slopes & Narrow Roads:
  - Steep slope: DOWNHILL vehicle yields to UPHILL vehicle.
  - Mountain road with cliff: Vehicle on MOUNTAIN WALL side must yield to vehicle on CLIFF EDGE side (to prevent catastrophic fall hazards).
• Engine Braking: When descending, use the SAME low gear used uphill (e.g. 2nd gear uphill ➜ 2nd gear downhill). NEVER coast in neutral (N) or turn off engine.
key_numbers: Police Gestures > Traffic Lights > Static Signs > General Rules
Straight-ahead traffic has priority over turning traffic
Left-turning traffic goes before right-turning traffic into single lane
Yield to vehicle on your RIGHT at equal uncontrolled intersections
Yield to vehicles INSIDE the roundabout (outer yields to inner)
Downhill yields to Uphill on narrow slopes
Mountain wall side yields to Cliff edge side on mountain roads

fines_table.why: Breach of priority hierarchy causing angular collision risk.

tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: At uncontrolled intersection between straight cars, left-side car yields to right-side car.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When two cars meet on a narrow mountain road, which of the following rules regarding right of way is correct?
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (1) Vehicles close to the mountain wall should yield to vehicles on the outer edge of the road.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: On mountain roads, vehicle on mountain wall side must yield to vehicle on cliff edge side.

tricky_bookmarks.question_text: When meeting another vehicle on a steep narrow slope:
tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (1) The downhill vehicle should yield to the uphill vehicle.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: On narrow slopes, downhill vehicle yields to uphill vehicle.

title: 🚶 Pedestrian Protection, Crosswalk Rules & Child Restraints
summary:
• Pedestrian Crosswalk Yielding Rules:
  - When approaching a crosswalk, driver must stop and maintain at least 3 METERS (or 3–4 zebra stripes) clearance from pedestrians.
  - Non-injury penalty: Fine of NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 + 3 demerit points + 3 hours mandatory safety training.
  - Causing minor injury: Fine of NT$18,000 to NT$36,000 + 6 months to 1 year driver license suspension.
  - Causing serious injury or death: Fine of NT$18,000 to NT$36,000 + 1 to 2 years license suspension / Revocation + Criminal liability increased by 50% (+1/2).
  - Visually Impaired Persons (White cane / Guide dog): Enhanced fine of NT$2,400 to NT$7,200.
• Child Safety Seats & Seating Rules:
  - Children <2 years old: Rear-facing child safety seat in the REAR SEAT.
  - Children 2 to 4 years old (<18 kg): Child safety seat in the REAR SEAT.
  - Children <12 years old: Strictly prohibited from sitting in front passenger seat.
  - Leaving child <6 years old unattended in car: NT$3,000 flat fine + 4 hours mandatory road safety course.
• Child Rear Door Safety Lock: When engaged, rear doors can ONLY be opened from the OUTSIDE.

title: 🔧 Vehicle Mechanics, Dashboard Warning Gauges & Diagnostics
summary:
• Tire Tread Groove Depth: Minimum 1.6 mm for passenger cars (0.8 mm for motorcycles), verified via Tread Wear Indicators (TWI). Under 1.6mm prohibits freeway access and causes hydroplaning in wet weather.
• Dashboard Warning Lights:
  - Red Engine Oil Can: Low engine oil pressure / lubrication failure. Pull over IMMEDIATELY to a safe spot, turn off engine, and check dipstick. Never continue driving!
  - Red Battery Light: Alternator / charging circuit failure (vehicle running on battery reserve only).
• Brake Diagnostics:
  - Spongy / Soft Brake Pedal: Air bubbles trapped in hydraulic brake fluid lines (requires bleeding).
  - Pedal drops ~1 inch upon starting engine: COMPLETELY NORMAL operation of vacuum brake booster.
• Exhaust Smoke Color Diagnostics:
  - Bluish-White Smoke: Engine burning motor oil (worn piston rings or valve seals).
  - Thick White Vapor Smoke: Coolant leaking into combustion chambers (blown head gasket).
  - Dense Black Smoke: Excessively rich air-fuel mixture / incomplete combustion.
  - Water dripping from tailpipe on cold start: NORMAL condensation phenomenon.
• Towing: Tow rope length 3 to 5 meters with yellow warning flag in center. For automatic front-wheel-drive (FWD) cars, lift front drive wheels to avoid transmission damage.
key_numbers: 1.6 mm: Minimum tire tread depth for cars (0.8 mm for motorcycles)
1 inch: Normal brake pedal drop upon starting engine with vacuum booster
3 to 5 meters: Length of towing rope with yellow flag
Blue Smoke = Burning Oil | White Smoke = Coolant Leak | Black Smoke = Rich Fuel
Red Oil Can Light = Pull over immediately and shut off engine

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (2) The driver should safely pull over to the side of the road and turn off the engine as soon as possible, check the oil level and contact a repair service, and should not continue driving.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: When the red oil can warning light turns on, pull over immediately and stop engine (not a simple maintenance reminder).

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (2) Burning engine oil.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Bluish-white exhaust smoke indicates the engine is burning motor oil.

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (1) Normal operation.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Brake pedal dropping ~1 inch upon engine ignition is COMPLETELY NORMAL booster operation.

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (3) Air in the brake fluid lines.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: A spongy brake pedal is caused by air trapped in hydraulic brake lines.

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (1) Tire overinflation.
tricky_bookmarks.trap_explanation: Center tread wear is caused by tire OVERINFLATION.

title: 📋 Licenses, Examinations, Demerits & Compulsory Auto Insurance
summary:
• Compulsory Automobile Liability Insurance (CALI):
  - Death / Permanent Disability Coverage: NT$2,000,000 per person.
  - Medical Expense Coverage: NT$200,000 per person.
  - Exclusion: Does NOT cover property damage or vehicle repairs.
  - Right of Subrogation: If at-fault driver was intoxicated, insurer pays victim then recovers 100% from drunk driver.
• Professional Licenses & Reviews:
  - Professional drivers <60 years: Periodic review once every 3 years. (Up to 6-month grace period upon return from travel/illness).
  - Professional drivers aged 65 to 68: Annual physical and dynamic vision exam.
  - Maximum professional driver age: 70 years (68–70 requires annual physical + cognitive exam).
• Senior Drivers (75+ years): License renewal every 3 years subject to physical and cognitive/dementia tests.
• Learner's Permit: Minimum 3 months practice for regular small car and 6 months for professional small car.
• Exam Passing Scores: Written Theory Exam = 85 points; Road Driving Test = 70 points.
• Hit-and-Run Penalties:
  - Property damage only: NT$1,000–$3,000 fine + 1 to 3 months license suspension.
  - With injury or fatality: PERMANENT LICENSE REVOCATION (Lifetime retest ban).
key_numbers: NT$2,000,000: Maximum death/disability coverage under Compulsory Insurance
NT$200,000: Maximum medical expense coverage under Compulsory Insurance
85 points: Passing score for written theoretical exam (car and motorcycle)
70 points: Passing score for road practical driving test
75+ years old: Renewal every 3 years with cognitive test
Every 3 years: Review interval for professional drivers <60 years old
5-year ban: Penalty for cheating or using an impersonator on driving exam

fines_table.why: Felony crime of abandoning injured victims in helpless state.

tricky_bookmarks.correct_answer: (3) Both the vehicle owner and the driver shall each be fined between NT$40,000 and NT$80,000, and one traffic violation record shall be added to the vehicle.

title: 🛑 Distinctive Road Lines, Widths, Shield Shapes & Route Signs
summary:
• Taiwan Highway Route Shields & Hierarchy:
  - 🌸 Plum Blossom (Flor de Ciruelo): National Freeway (Freeway No. 1, 3, 5).
  - 🔴 Red Shield: Provincial Expressway (Provincial Route 61, 64, 66, 74, 88).
  - 🔵 Blue Shield: Standard Provincial Highway (Provincial Route 1, 9).
  - ⬜ White Rectangle / Square: County / City Highway (County Route 106, 114).
• Line Widths & Pavement Markings:
  - 10 cm solid white line: Fast/slow lane dividing line.
  - 15 cm solid white line: Roadway outer edge line.
  - 20–30 cm solid white line: Stop line before crosswalk / intersection.
  - Double solid yellow line: No crossing, overtaking, or U-turns 24/7.
  - Solid red curb line: No stopping or parking 24/7.
  - Solid yellow curb line: Temporary stops (<3 min) permitted; no parking from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
• Median Island Signs: 'Keep Right' installed at approach end; 'Keep Left' installed at departure end.
